newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway Seafoods granted listing on Oslo Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Norway Seafoods granted listing on Oslo Bourse.

text.p: The Oslo Bourse said on Tuesday it had approved a request by Norway Seafoods, the fisheries division of Aker RGI ASA, to be listed on the stock exchange.
A statement said Norway Seafoods ASA would be quoted on the bourse provided a satisfactory placement of shares is made and provided that a valid introductory prospect is presented.

Aker RGI said on Monday that Norway Seafoods shareholder Tiger Management and funds administred by Tiger would sell a minimum 3,250,000 and a maximum 11,652,175 shares in a secondary placement in Norway and overseas as part of the listing.
The price will be 55 crowns per share. The purchase period was set as April 21-30 and Norway Seafood was expected to be listed from mid-May.
